entities.summary: Babushkin, known as Mysovsk (Мысовск) before 1941, is a town in Kabansky District of the Republic of Buryatia, Russia, located on the southern shore of Lake Baikal on the Trans-Siberian Railway. Population: 4,831 (2010 census); 4,953 (2002 census); 7,298 (1989 Soviet census); 9,000 (1967).
